QuestInfo.name: Embers in the Garden
QuestInfo.0: A cave fairy named #b#p715##k keeps a campfire burning in #b#m010006022##k. She looks like she could use a hand.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p715##k says #r#o60#s#k keep crawling up from #b#m010006100##k toward her campfire. Defeat #r60 #o60#s#k so the camp stays safe.
QuestInfo.2: I cleared out the #o60#s, and #b#p715##k's fire burns quietly again. She seemed to want to talk about something else, too...

0.0: Oh! A human, all the way out here? Come, sit by the fire. The benches are a little crooked, but they're dry.
0.1: I'm #b#p715##k. I keep this camp for #b#p711##k. He brings me news from the surface, and I keep the fire lit for anyone who passes through. It's a fair trade.
0.2: The trouble is the #r#o60#s#k. They love warmth, and they crawl all the way up from #b#m010006100##k to curl around my fire pit. Last night one of them chewed through a bench!
0.3: Could you thin them out for me? #r60#k should be enough to make the rest think twice.

yes.0: Thank you! You'll find plenty of #r#o60#s#k in #b#m010006100##k and #b#m010006110##k. Come back and warm up when you're done.

no.0: That's all right. The fire will keep. Sit a while if you like.

1.0: You're back, and not a single scorch mark on you! The camp's been quiet since you left.
1.1: Here, take these. Travelers who keep my fire safe never leave empty-handed.
1.2: ...Can I tell you something? I don't often get to talk to anyone out here.

mob.0: The #r#o60#s#k are still crawling toward the fire. Please defeat #r60#k of them in #b#m010006100##k.
